items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Jimmy and I played together in Indianapolis.

ctx.x: I went to hear Coltrane. It changed my life. Jimmy and I played together in Indianapolis. The club was the Embers. That was called the Embers. Down the street in another club, Coltrane was playing. He was playing on our night off, so we went, and it was the original group. It was McCoy [Tyner], Jimmy Garrison, Elvin [Jones], and Monk.
